subject: Follow-up on banner delivery
text: Hello, I am following up on the purchase confirmation for our club banner order. Payment was made yesterday afternoon. I need to mention a complication: the venue moved its setup table away from the main stage, so delivery may use the rear service lane instead of the front entrance. Please also confirm whether your driver can do that without an extra charge for us. If not, tell me quickly, and I will rearrange the setup. The event begins at noon tomorrow, so an early delivery is preferred.
